seoTitle: Free Regex Escape and Unescape Tool Online
metaDescription: Escape literal text so it can sit safely inside a regular expression for JavaScript, Python, Java, PHP, Go or POSIX, or unescape it. Free, in-browser.
intro: Paste literal text and get it escaped for use inside a regular expression in JavaScript, Python, Java, PHP, Go or POSIX, or reverse the escaping.
why:
A regex treats characters such as dot, plus, brackets and dollar as syntax. If you want to match a price like $5.00 (approx.) literally, you must put backslashes in front of the right characters, and the exact set differs by language. Missing one produces a pattern that matches the wrong text or fails to compile.

This tool escapes the metacharacters for the flavour you choose. Python also escapes the space, hyphen and hash; PHP escapes more punctuation; POSIX ERE uses a smaller set. Unescape removes a backslash before any character. Built-in escape functions exist in most languages, such as re.escape or Pattern.quote, and are the safer choice inside code. Use this for quick checks and for patterns you paste into configs.
howTo: Choose escape or unescape and the language flavour.
Paste the text you want to match literally.
Copy the result into your regular expression.

faq.q: Why do the flavours give different results?
faq.a: Each language has its own set of special characters and some escape extras. Python escapes space, hyphen and hash for verbose mode, and PHP escapes characters used by its delimiters.

faq.q: Does it add delimiters or flags?
faq.a: No. It escapes the text only. Add slashes, quotes or flags yourself, and double the backslashes if you put the pattern in a normal string literal.
It removes the backslash from every backslash plus character pair and keeps the character. It does not convert sequences such as \n or \t into control characters.

faq.q: Should I use this in application code?
faq.a: Prefer the escape function from your language standard library inside code, since it is maintained for that language. This page is for quick use and configs.
